related_cases.quote: For a test with \(\alpha\) --> = 0.05 and \(\beta\) --> = 0.10, the minimum sample size required for the test is $$ N = (1.645 + 1.282)^2 = 8.567 \approx 9 \, . $$ N = (1.645 + 1.282)2 = 8.567 ~ 9.

related_cases.quote: Take the example discussed above where the the minimum sample size is computed to be \(N\) N --> = 9. This estimate is low. Now use the formula above with degrees of freedom \(N\) N --> - 1 = 8 which gives a second estimate of $$ N = (1.860 + 1.397)^2 = 10.6 \approx 11 \, . $$ N = (1.860 + 1.397)2 = 10.6 ~11.
